choices.graph: largest connected component of the undirected simple graph (self-loops removed)
choices.sigma2: T1 closed form; isolates L_ii=0. After LCC, n0 is typically 0.
choices.gcn: Kipf-Welling renormalisation (A+I), hidden=32, Adam lr=0.01, wd=5e-4, dropout=0.5, early stopping on val acc
choices.sgc: same P=(A+I) propagator, then StandardScaler + logistic regression on train nodes
choices.splits: Planetoid official split with random inits; geom-GCN / Platonov official splits otherwise
choices.intervention: greedy delete+add scored by exact T2 composition, reject disconnecting or isolate-creating swaps; random control uses the median swap count
